contract: Register verification always submits verifier-chosen activationPassword as newPassword,6..100chars.
Same-page registration can prefill only its current in-memory submitted password; direct verify refresh/link and unverified-login verification start empty and require fresh entry.
Changing activation password allocates fresh retry key; same OTP/password/body retry reuses key.
No password/code/request key is persisted in verify-context or local/session storage.
Guest transfer remains deferred with unchanged household and an explicit same-code continuation.

Forgot final remains direct; pending-delivery correct-code requests that already became terminal OTP_INVALID keep their key. User recovers after cooldown through an explicit new resend/generation; never automatically rotates a key on OTP_INVALID.
